Bay World

Bay World

A free-roam city on the training campus: walk or drive anywhere, day turns to night, traffic keeps to its own lanes, and every job board is a real training station. Finish a shift, earn reputation and credits, and unlock the rest of the fleet.

Controls — Keyboard: WASD or the arrows to move, Shift to run, E to open a job board, F to enter or exit a vehicle, V for the camera, M for the map. Driving uses the platform's own drive keys (throttle/brake W/S, steer A/D). Touch: the on-screen stick and buttons. Gamepad: the left stick moves or steers.

Every zone, landmark, site, vehicle livery and tune here is original to this platform — no third-party place, game, character or music.
